root_causes.title: Buyer-stated requirement values are never written to the lead
root_causes.why: On every call where the buyer stated a quantity/unit/spec, the captured fields (quantity, quantity_unit, specifications, buyer_name, city/state) are empty in the agent's final variables, and no capture tool fires (only end_interaction / change_output_language appear). The phase machine also stays in REQUIREMENT CONFIRMATION and quantity_asked_count stays 0. Observed fact: the fields are empty. Inference: the write step is not executing in this build.

evidence.quote: buyer: दो सौ चाहिए थे  (captured quantity = '')

root_causes.title: Agent asserts a location the buyer never gave
root_causes.why: The agent confirms a triangulated/default city ('Noida') as if the buyer had stated it, which confuses and mildly frustrates buyers and risks a wrong lead. Evidence is transcript + the audit_frustration='mild' flag.

evidence.quote: agent: आप Noida से call कर रहे हैं, सही है?  → buyer: आपको लोकेशन कैसे पता चली?
agent: आप Noida से call कर रहे हैं, सही है?  → buyer: नहीं, मैं हरियाणा से हूँ

root_causes.title: Long silences before the agent re-engages
root_causes.why: Gaps of 5-9s occur before the agent speaks again (measured from turn timestamps).

root_causes.title: Handover/transfer promised while nothing was captured
root_causes.why: The agent tells the buyer 'requirement noted' / 'transferring you to a seller' but no handover tool fires (connect_ast_call stays 0), and the captured fields are empty. Evidence: transcript promises + tool trace.

evidence.quote: agent: आपकी requirement note हो गई है ... WhatsApp पर share कर दिए जाएंगे
agent: अब मैं आपकी call एक best seller को transfer कर रहा हूँ

root_causes.title: Language not held steady mid-call
root_causes.why: The agent switches between Hindi and English within a call and answers English turns in Hindi, which the scripted English calls show clearly.

evidence.quote: agent: जी। दरअसल, जिस seller को आप call कर रहे थे ...  (buyer was speaking English)

root_causes.title: Product understood only after buyer corrections
root_causes.why: The agent opens by presuming a product and needs several buyer corrections to reach the real one (laptop → laptop sleeve; plane → paper plane; a hardcoded 'PVC Pipe' opening).

evidence.quote: agent: क्या आपको PVC Pipe की requirement है?  (buyer stated no product)
buyer: नहीं, मेरे को प्लेन चाहिए  (after 'जूते')

fixes.title: Require the stated quantity/unit/spec to be written before closing
fixes.note: Minimal edit to the capture instruction so the value is persisted, not just acknowledged.
fixes.before: Acknowledge the quantity and specification the buyer shares.
fixes.after: Acknowledge the quantity and specification the buyer shares, and always write the stated quantity, its unit and any specification to their capture fields before the call ends — a value that is only acknowledged is lost.

fixes.title: Never assert a location the buyer did not give
fixes.note: Stop presenting a triangulated city as if the buyer stated it.
fixes.before: Confirm the buyer's city before sharing seller details.
fixes.after: Ask the buyer for their city; never state or confirm a city the buyer has not given — a triangulated guess must not be presented as fact.

test.name: No presumed location
test.scenario: Triangulation default is Noida; buyer is from Haryana.

fixes.title: Re-prompt sooner after silence
fixes.before: If the buyer is silent, ask whether they are still on the line.
fixes.after: If the buyer is silent for about 3 seconds, re-prompt promptly instead of waiting 5-9 seconds.

test.name: Prompt re-prompt
test.scenario: Buyer silent after the agent's turn.

blockers.title: Captured requirement variables are empty on all 9 calls
blockers.detail: quantity, quantity_unit, specifications, buyer_name, buyer_disposition and call_outcome are blank in the agent's final variables for every call, and the only tools that fire are end_interaction and change_output_language — no capture/write tool. The phase machine also stays in REQUIREMENT CONFIRMATION with quantity_asked_count=0. Until this is resolved, Data Accuracy (capture) cannot be distinguished from a genuine miss.

blockers.title: All 9 calls are debug calls
blockers.detail: is_debug_call=1 on every interaction; callers are internal (rounak.pol***, keshav.sar***, +91******1858). These may not represent production traffic, and audio_url is null on all of them.

blockers.title: No per-turn timestamps on the English calls
blockers.detail: audio_start_time/audio_end_time are all 0.0 on the three English washing-machine calls, so dead air is Unscorable there.
